Brief clarifications and controls:
- RTO approach: for stateless inference we rely on continuous batching + routing to healthy pools; measured RTOs are typically under 30s (95th). For stateful session persistence the restore path depends on snapshot size and network attach; practical RTO for the session store is 2–7 minutes.
- RPO approach: session store checkpoints every 5 minutes; archival snapshot cadence is hourly. Worst-case observed RPO during routine operation is 5 minutes; we retain messaging logs for 30 days.
- Maintenance windows: scheduled maintenance is announced 48 hours in advance in the Console; standard weekly maintenance window is Sun 02:00–04:00 UTC. Major version rollouts use canary steps to avoid service-wide disruption.

Limitations/gaps:
- We did not include internal debug logs or full incident timelines in this packet. We referenced INF-4921 (internal ticket) for the 2026-09-14 event; if FinTrust needs the full timeline we can provide a redacted incident timeline subject to a mutual NDA.
